sentences.text: Gang Signs & Prayer is the debut studio album by English grime artist Stormzy .	Stormzy	Stormzy	grime	grime (music)	studio album	studio album

It was released on 24 February 2017 independently through #Merky Records while being distributed by ADA of Warner Music Group .	Warner Music	Warner Music	ADA	Alternative Distribution Alliance	Warner Music Group	Warner Music Group
It is Stormzy 's first major commercial release , following the Dreamers Disease EP -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .	Stormzy	Stormzy

The album features guest appearances from fellow MCs Wretch 32 , Ghetts and J Hus , along with singers Kehlani , Raleigh Ritchie and MNEK .	Wretch 32	Wretch 32	Ghetts	Ghetts	J Hus	J Hus	Kehlani	Kehlani	Raleigh Ritchie	Raleigh Ritchie	MNEK	MNEK
It features production from Fraser T Smith and Sir Spyro , among others .	Fraser T Smith	Fraser T Smith
The album was supported by the lead single `` Big for Your Boots '' .	Big for Your Boots	Big for Your Boots

Gang Signs & Prayer received critical acclaim upon release , and entered the UK Albums Chart at number 1 with sales of 69,000 , becoming the first grime album in history to reach number 1 .	grime	grime (music)	UK Albums Chart	UK Albums Chart
It holds the distinction of having every song from the album appear concurrently on the UK Singles Chart , including 7 songs in the Top 40 .
